summary: Stage 3 closed. Run rm-role-designer-1795773471 wrote the design and died on an API 529 before its result; this run finished it. On disk: sheet.md, tree.json (12 six-part bars, whole bar whole_journey, 12 checks, 17 rules, 17 meetings), plan.md (with the offline-simulation answer: yes for the repair state machine and the onboarding table, no for the rest), scenes.json (22 acceptance, 2 interaction and 4 exploration scenes; 3 showcases, flagship smelter_comes_home by a delegated pick), floor.json, models.md and root.md. Gate A lint passes and the showcase set is accepted. This run: (1) filed the build item RIMMANDRAKE_SCRIPT_WRECKED_MACHINES_SCENES_EVERY_REPAIR_A_FOIL with its acceptance test, seen red (23 entry points missing), published at 694c69f167; (2) wrote version/next_version/README.md, the eight 'later' lines of the sheet as pre-written tickets, which opens no version; (3) ran one fresh reader (rm-judge, opus) over the whole design: all 18 quotes of the sheet are word for word in their events, and four significant faults were found and fixed here. The largest: the repair bar promised the repair of a found wreck where it stands, and the ground rule refused it on a ruin's floor. The game's source (GenConstruct.CanPlaceBlueprintOver) and the factory mod's floor def settle the rule: a wreck names no ground need, the colony lays factory floor under it or carries it onto floor, and the scene sc_repair_needs_ground must show both ways in play. The others: the whole bar's first picture now matches the one Ancient Component of its scenes; the settings scene can no longer pass on settings that never apply; rule R_lift says what a narrowing of the lift does. No bar was added and no bar's 'says' changed. Open for later stages: one meeting is unknown (study on a building; the spike is built first); his reaction to the 9 captures of the first look is not on the ledger, and a word from him reopens stage 2.

quick_look.why: no question goes to him at this stage; the first look of 2026-11-26 was played and its readings are in the design (record decision d_first_look_read)
